cmds: python -c "import os, pkg_resources; from tqdm import tqdm; pkgs = sorted([(p.project_name, p.location) for p in pkg_resources.working_set], key=lambda x: x[0]); print('--- Package Sizes ---'); total = 0; for name, loc in tqdm(pkgs): size = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(d, f)) for d, _, fs in os.walk(loc) for f in fs); print(f'{name:<30} {size / 1024 / 1024:>10.2f} MB'); total += size; print(f'--- Total Size: {total / 1024 / 1024:.2f} MB ---')"
echo 'Build finished. Check logs for package sizes.' > index.html
